1.consolidated_definition: "Cabeciduro": objeto mobiliario, término coloquial que se refiere a un tipo de cama o sofá con respaldo alto y apoyos para la cabeza.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Headrest piece of furniture: colloquial term referring to a type of bed or sofa with high back and head supports.
